description:
> *Generated by AI from the C verification research (docs/research/c-verification-macos.md).*

1. priv/defk_runtime.h:1713 passes int64_t* (long long*) to enif_get_int64, which takes long* on macOS. Apple clang warns on every build; Homebrew LLVM 22/23 errors, so no kernel builds with them. Fix: declare the local ErlNifSInt64.
2. On glibc, clang (with defk's -fno-builtin) does not treat __sigsetjmp as returns_twice, so guard_k*'s 'return run_k*()' after sigsetjmp becomes a tail call and a raise's siglongjmp lands in a dead frame: Bus error. Reproduced 2026-10-13 in a podman arm64 Debian container: CC=clang mix test test/raise_test.exs dies at the first raise. gcc and Apple clang are unaffected. Fix: redeclare __sigsetjmp with __attribute__((returns_twice)) under __GLIBC__ in defk_runtime.h.

Done when: both fixed, a test pins (1) on the host (clang -Werror=incompatible-pointer-types -fsyntax-only on the header), and the container run of raise_test with CC=clang passes.
title: Runtime header portability: enif_get_int64 pointer type (Homebrew LLVM error) and __sigsetjmp returns_twice on glibc (clang raise crashes the node)
